statement: SUInitialize must be called before any other C API function and SUTerminate when done; SUGetAPIVersion returns the major and minor API version (reliable from SDK 8.2).

source.ref: SketchUp C API: initialize, terminate and API version

superiority: Stable C ABI with a semantic-version guarantee and a published ABI-compatibility test.
notes: C API area names follow the publicly distributed SDK reference Acceptance sketch: Load the library, initialize, query version, terminate 100 times with no leak and no crash.

statement: SUModelCreate makes an empty model, SUModelCreateFromFile and SUModelCreateFromBuffer load a .skp (with status variants), and SUModelSaveToFile or SUModelSaveToFileWithVersion write it, the latter for a chosen SketchUp file version.

source.ref: C API: model open, create, save and version conversion

superiority: Streaming reader that avoids loading the whole file.
notes: C API area names follow the publicly distributed SDK reference Acceptance sketch: Open a sample .skp, save as an earlier version, reopen; entity counts equal. Also: https://extensions.sketchup.com/developers/sketchup_c_api/sketchup/model__version_8h.html

statement: SUEntitiesRef creates and enumerates faces, edges, curves, arc curves, groups, instances, images, guide lines and points, texts, dimensions and section planes through its Add and Get functions (for example SUEntitiesAddFaces, SUEntitiesGetNumFaces, SUEntitiesGetFaces).

source.ref: C API: entities collection (faces, edges, groups, instances, guides, text, dimensions)

superiority: Bulk creation APIs with O(n) insertion.
notes: C API area names follow the publicly distributed SDK reference Acceptance sketch: Build a cube from faces; count faces and edges; volume computed from vertices equals closed form.

statement: SUGeometryInputRef collects vertices, edges, faces (with inner loops), curves and per-face materials, layers and smooth/soft/hidden flags, and SUEntitiesFill commits them to an entities collection in one call.
superiority: Parallel builder with no per-face validation overhead.
notes: C API area names follow the publicly distributed SDK reference Acceptance sketch: Build a 100k-triangle mesh in under the time budget; face count equal and normals consistent.

statement: Topology is reachable through SUFaceRef (edges, edge uses, vertices, outer and inner loops, normal, area), SULoopRef (vertices, edges, winding, convexity), SUEdgeUseRef (partners, previous and next), SUVertexRef, SUCurveRef and SUArcCurveRef (radius, center, start and end angle).

source.ref: C API: face, loop, edge, vertex and curve

notes: C API area names follow the publicly distributed SDK reference Acceptance sketch: Traverse a fixture; loop counts, vertex positions and adjacency equal expected. Also: https://extensions.sketchup.com/developers/sketchup_c_api/sketchup/struct_s_u_loop_ref.html https://extensions.sketchup.com/developers/sketchup_c_api/sketchup/struct_s_u_edge_use_ref.html https://extensions.sketchup.com/developers/sketchup_c_api/sketchup/struct_s_u_vertex_ref.html https://extensions.sketchup.com/developers/sketchup_c_api/sketchup/struct_s_u_curve_ref.html https://extensions.sketchup.com/developers/sketchup_c_api/sketchup/struct_s_u_arc_curve_ref.html

statement: SUComponentDefinitionRef creates definitions (name, description, entities, behavior, insert point, instances) and SUComponentDefinitionCreateInstance makes instances whose transform, name, guid and lock state are set through SUComponentInstanceRef; SUInstancePathRef tracks nested instance paths and their transforms.

source.ref: C API: components, definitions and instances

notes: C API area names follow the publicly distributed SDK reference Acceptance sketch: Create definition, 3 instances with transforms; world bounds equal. Also: https://extensions.sketchup.com/developers/sketchup_c_api/sketchup/struct_s_u_component_instance_ref.html https://extensions.sketchup.com/developers/sketchup_c_api/sketchup/struct_s_u_instance_path_ref.html

statement: SUGroupRef creates groups with name, guid, transform and entities, and SUAttributeDictionaryRef stores key/value pairs whose values are SUTypedValueRef objects (byte, int, float, double, bool, color, time, string, vector, array).

source.ref: C API: groups and entity attributes

notes: C API area names follow the publicly distributed SDK reference Acceptance sketch: Set and read typed values of 6 types; round trip through save. Also: https://extensions.sketchup.com/developers/sketchup_c_api/sketchup/struct_s_u_attribute_dictionary_ref.html https://extensions.sketchup.com/developers/sketchup_c_api/sketchup/struct_s_u_typed_value_ref.html

statement: SUMaterialRef sets color, opacity, texture and PBR workflow data (metallic, roughness, normal and ambient-occlusion textures and factors), SUTextureRef loads or writes textures, and SUTextureWriterRef writes the textures of entities to files.
superiority: Full PBR model with OpenPBR mapping.
notes: C API area names follow the publicly distributed SDK reference Acceptance sketch: Create material with texture; read back size and file; PBR map presence. Also: https://extensions.sketchup.com/developers/sketchup_c_api/sketchup/struct_s_u_texture_ref.html https://extensions.sketchup.com/developers/sketchup_c_api/sketchup/struct_s_u_texture_writer_ref.html

statement: SUImageRepRef holds image pixel data with SUImageRepSetData, SUImageRepGetData, SUImageRepLoadFile, SUImageRepSaveToFile, SUImageRepResize and pixel color lookup by UV.
superiority: In-memory images are decoded once and shared by materials, textures and exports without copies.
notes: C API area names follow the publicly distributed SDK reference Acceptance sketch: Load a PNG; pixel values equal.

statement: SUCameraRef holds perspective or orthographic camera parameters, SUSceneRef holds per-scene camera, style, layer visibility and animation inclusion, SUStylesRef lists and applies styles, and SULayerRef (tags) has name, visibility and line style.

source.ref: C API: camera, scenes, styles, layers (tags)

superiority: Scene and camera data is available as plain structures that map one-to-one to the scripting API.
notes: C API area names follow the publicly distributed SDK reference Acceptance sketch: Create scenes with cameras; read back values within 1e-9. Also: https://extensions.sketchup.com/developers/sketchup_c_api/sketchup/struct_s_u_scene_ref.html https://extensions.sketchup.com/developers/sketchup_c_api/sketchup/struct_s_u_styles_ref.html https://extensions.sketchup.com/developers/sketchup_c_api/sketchup/struct_s_u_layer_ref.html

statement: The geometry types SUPoint3D, SUVector3D, SUPlane3D, SUBoundingBox3D and SUTransformation have helper functions such as SUPoint3DOffset, SUPoint3DDistanceToSUPoint3D, SUBoundingBox3DGetMidPoint, SUTransformationRotation, SUTransformationInterpolate and SUTransformationMultiply; points and vectors compare equal within a 0.001 inch tolerance.

source.ref: C API: transformations and geometry types

notes: C API area names follow the publicly distributed SDK reference Acceptance sketch: Compose transforms; matrices equal reference within 1e-12. Also: https://extensions.sketchup.com/developers/sketchup_c_api/sketchup/struct_s_u_point3_d.html https://extensions.sketchup.com/developers/sketchup_c_api/sketchup/struct_s_u_bounding_box3_d.html

statement: The model exposes units (SUModelGetUnits), rendering options and shadow info as key/value sets (SURenderingOptionsGetKeys, SUShadowInfoGetValue) and its geographic location (SULocationGetLatLong, SULocationGetNorthAngle).

source.ref: C API: units, options and model info

superiority: Options are enumerable and typed so tools can discover settings without hard-coded keys.
notes: C API area names follow the publicly distributed SDK reference Acceptance sketch: Set and read units; location lat/long equal. Also: https://extensions.sketchup.com/developers/sketchup_c_api/sketchup/struct_s_u_rendering_options_ref.html https://extensions.sketchup.com/developers/sketchup_c_api/sketchup/struct_s_u_shadow_info_ref.html https://extensions.sketchup.com/developers/sketchup_c_api/sketchup/struct_s_u_location_ref.html

statement: SUClassificationsLoadSchema loads a classification schema into a model, SUClassificationsGetSchemas lists loaded schemas, and SUComponentInstanceCreateClassificationInfo returns the classifications (schema names, types and attributes) attached to an instance.

source.ref: C API: classifications and IFC data

notes: C API area names follow the publicly distributed SDK reference Acceptance sketch: Assign IfcWall; round trip. Also: https://extensions.sketchup.com/developers/sketchup_c_api/sketchup/struct_s_u_classification_info_ref.html

statement: Native API to create and edit LayOut documents: pages, layers, entities, dimensions, tables, SketchUp model viewports, export.
notes: C API area names follow the publicly distributed SDK reference Acceptance sketch: Create a document with a page, a viewport and a dimension; export PDF; counts equal. UNVERIFIED: the public C API reference covers models, geometry and the importer/exporter interface but its LayOut section is not reachable on an allowed host (the layout/ reference path returns access denied); the LayOut document API statement cannot be checked, so the row stays open.

statement: Most functions return an SUResult (SU_ERROR_NONE on success, with codes such as SU_ERROR_NULL_POINTER_INPUT, SU_ERROR_INVALID_INPUT, SU_ERROR_OUT_OF_RANGE and SU_ERROR_MODEL_VERSION), and all C API calls must be made from the main thread.

source.ref: C API: errors, result codes and thread-safety

superiority: Thread-safe read access for parallel exporters.
notes: C API area names follow the publicly distributed SDK reference Acceptance sketch: Fuzz invalid references; every call returns a documented error and none crashes. Also: https://extensions.sketchup.com/developers/sketchup_c_api/sketchup/index.html

statement: A native importer or exporter module implements SketchUpModelImporterInterface or SketchUpModelExporterInterface (identifier, file extensions, description, optional options dialog) and appears as an import or export option inside SketchUp.

source.ref: C API: importer and exporter plug-in model

superiority: Importers and exporters are plug-ins in a sandboxed process so a faulty converter cannot crash the application.
notes: C API area names follow the publicly distributed SDK reference Acceptance sketch: Build sample exporter; opens in the target program. Also: https://extensions.sketchup.com/developers/sketchup_c_api/sketchup/class_sketch_up_model_exporter_interface.html

statement: Native and Ruby procedural components via Procedure protocol (2027.0).
superiority: Open procedure graph format that can be inspected, diffed and executed headless.
notes: also: https://ruby.sketchup.com/Sketchup/Procedure.html Acceptance sketch: Run a procedure with parameter change; deterministic result hash.
